conclusion: Feature-view CPU gradient redistributes cotangent feature chunks before full-B4/D16 scatter into[32,16] and converts the result directly to FP32 storage, with no post-scatter data sum. Legacy has the same full-batch/feature-shard grouping. Original native scatters B2/D32 partials then reduces data and slices features. CPU optimized operations use F32 legalization and explicit BF16 round-trips in scalar scatter reducers; only StableHLO expresses the BF16 add directly. Typed TPU realization remains untested.
